claims.gist: Most cloud security programs began with posture, which answers what could go wrong
CDR answers what is going wrong now by detecting and responding to active threats
Context turns a single API call into a meaningful signal
CSPM is preventive and snapshot-based; CDR is detective and near real-time
EDR cannot see control-plane attacks, such as stolen keys copying storage through APIs
Cloud-native detections like GuardDuty are usually limited to one cloud with less context
Demos look good, so measure detection quality in your own environment
Run a proof of concept on real accounts for at least two weeks with simulated attacks
Noisy detection tools will be ignored within a month

thesis: CDR answers what is going wrong now; evaluate vendors on real-environment detection quality, coverage, noise and identity context.
